notes:
Lead details & notes:
- Came in via site (product sign-up). Primary contact: Sofia Lim (VP Product).
- Use case: replace rule-based triage + patient intake forms with a chat-first flow; generate clinical note summaries and embeddings for search.
- Latency/throughput: p95 chat <= 250ms desirable for patient-facing quick replies; bulk embeddings ok to be queued overnight (batch).
- Model preference: open models encouraged (cost), but willing to use Redwood curated models if latency/cost tradeoff is clear.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — wants per-call predictability to budget for pilots across 4 clinics.
- Security: "HIPAA-adjacent" language used by legal — not storing full PHI at pilot stage but need to understand what Redwood considers PHI in logs and whether token-level redaction/PII scrubbing can be enforced.
- Retention: Want default 30-day ephemeral logs for trial; legal requests a documented retention-control and ability to turn off request logs for specific routes.
- Auth: Require SSO/SAML for admin console and role-based access; API keys for service-to-service calls acceptable for now.
- Observability: Wants per-route cost/latency dashboard; interested in Redwood Console demo on tracing and token breakdown.
- POC: Proposed 6-week pilot w/ 2 clinician-facing clinics. POC scope: chat intake flow + embeddings for internal KB. Success metrics: NPS for intake flow, reduction in manual triage time, embedding search accuracy vs baseline.
- Quote from Sofia on discovery call: "We need clear assurances on what data persists and how we can delete logs programmatically — can't hand this to legal as vague."
- Action items: Share Hosted API retention one-pager, give sample curl snippets showing streaming + role-based keys, propose dates for legal sync (week of 2026-03-15).
- Risks: If legal deems hosted API unacceptable for PHI even with retention controls, they will request Dedicated or Private — complicates SMB motion.
- Helpful links: pricing one-pager & retention sample provided in Drive links above.
- Next AE task: follow up after sending docs, confirm pilot budget and timeline.
